Used by CivilCraft (assets/apps/civilcraft/<build>/gpkg.js) only when a GeoPackage is read or written; it passes the
wasm bytes itself (wasmBinary), fetched from this folder. Upgrade: drop a new version folder made the same way, then
`ln -sfn <version> current`.
